title: Read a JSON body
summary: Express.js: Read a JSON body. Send an empty object and read the 400 reply.
introduction: POST can send a body. Send POST /books with Content-Type application/json and body {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON body with Express.js
Send an empty object and read the 400 reply

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Read a JSON body

blocks.text: express.json has already parsed the body. The title check passes, so status 201 and that title are returned.
Send an empty object and read the 400 reply.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: express.json must run before routes that read a JSON body.
